qa_pairs.question: What information do the disk operation graphs on the GPU Task Page display?
qa_pairs.answer: On the GPU Task Page, the left graph illustrates the evolution of input/output operations per second (IOPS) performed on the local disk over time. The right graph shows the evolution of the bandwidth used on the local disk over time, representing the quantity of data read or written per second.

qa_pairs.question: What does IOPS (input/output operations per second) represent in the context of the disk operation graphs on the GPU Task Page?
qa_pairs.answer: In the disk operation graphs on the GPU Task Page, IOPS signifies the number of read and write commands executed on the local disk over time.
